svg.aria-label: Six-step reference-genome pipeline left to right: taxon list, samples, DNA-quality gate, sequence, assemble and annotate, deposit; below it two outcomes, a complete nuclear genome as the primary route and a mitogenome when gDNA quality blocks whole-genome sequencing as the fallback route
svg.title: Phase 1: reference genomes first
svg.text: Phase 1 builds what the region does not have: chromosome-level reference genomes for under-represented
Western Pacific taxa, to VGP-tier standards, in the open record.
